summary: Mostly it sounds like DUMMIES: flat, procedural worker lines with resentment underneath, and no FARSIGHT slogans. Five lines need changes: two assign a job to every car of a class, one claims a stop for any avoidance, one claims the dummy leaned on a car, and one mocks the player.

issues.rule: Only SEDAN-01 is published as a depot parcel courier, so a parcel line cannot be spoken by every sedan model.
Only VAN-02 is published as doing lane maintenance, so a maintenance line cannot be spoken by every van model.
A bark cannot invent a manoeuvre the evidence does not support. cause 'body' also covers a swerve, but the line says 'Stopping'.

issues.found: Please do not lean on the vehicle.
issues.rule: The knock event logs only that a car pushed the dummy back (model, speed). It does not log that the dummy leaned on anything, so the line asserts an unlogged act.
issues.fix: Contact logged. Please stand clear of the vehicle.

issues.rule: Vehicle lines never mock the player. A thought should carry the car's own fear or resentment about its job.
issues.fix: If it lunges again, I will be late.
